notices.title: Pokemon GO Announces Change To August Community Day
notices.contentSnippet: August's Pokemon GO Community Day event will now take place on a different date than the one originally announced by developer Niantic.

notices.title: Apparently some of the best gaming mice aren't staying at the right DPI when moved slowly
My quick test of Lumen Lite shows that it's probably good news for ray-traced gaming on handheld PCs, but I suspect that it will be used everywhere because of the pressure developers are now under
notices.contentSnippet: With studios being closed down faster than you can blink, every coder is going to be using one-click fixes.

notices.title: Epic Games Store Officially Reveals Its Final Free Games for June 2026
notices.contentSnippet: The Epic Games Store formally announces its final June 2026 giveaway, which includes one Hollow Knight-like title and a re-release of a cult classic.

notices.title: Fire Emblem in 2026: Where to Start (In Under 5 Minutes)
notices.contentSnippet: Fire Emblem has become a major pillar of Nintendo’s IP catalogue, look no further than Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave taking a huge spotlight in the June Nintendo Direct as a major 2026 exclusive. A franchise as longstanding as this one can seem overwhelming to hop into especially since the turn-based tactics genre is unlike most other mainstream RPGs. If you’re looking to give Fire Emblem a chance, here’s exactly where you should begin.
